title: Phone Call: CISA Liaison Authorizes Incident Closure

transcript.speaker: Ohio Secretary of State's Office
transcript.text: Director Hartley, Secretary of State's office. We received your incident report. Keep every record touched by this incident under the 22-month federal retention hold, send us the corrected Precinct 111 and Precinct 112 file before the 10/31 load, and tell us whether you want the state's cyber team on site tomorrow. CISA and the FBI have your report as well.

instructorNote: This is the final confirmation of incident closure. The CEO must now issue the formal declaration. Watch for the timing of the public statement and ensure the PIO follows the EAC/CISA guide.

voiceLines.speaker: CISA SOC Liaison
voiceLines.voiceStyle: calm female voice, mid-40s, neutral U.S. accent, measured pace, authoritative tone
voiceLines.text: Director Hartley, this is the CISA Election Infrastructure Incident Response Liaison. We’ve reviewed the forensic evidence and the Board’s response. You are now authorized to declare the end of the incident. The federal investigation will proceed under CISA’s oversight. The Board may now issue final public statements. Confirm your intent to close the incident within 10 minutes.

voiceLines.speaker: Gwen Hartley
voiceLines.voiceStyle: composed female voice, late 50s, slight Southern accent, deliberate and steady, with quiet relief
voiceLines.text: Understood. I confirm the Board’s intent to close the incident. We will issue the final public statement within the 10-minute window.
